stem.en: Bromine has two isotopes in nature: bromine-79 (49.7%) and bromine-81 (50.3%). Find the average atomic mass of bromine in u.

explanation.en: Multiply each mass by its percentage and add: (79 × 49.7/100) + (81 × 50.3/100) = 39.263 + 40.743 = 80.0 u, to one decimal place. The two isotopes are almost equally common, so the average is close to the middle. No bromine atom has a mass of 80 u.

hints.en: Multiply each mass by its percentage divided by 100, then add the two answers.
